messages:
rae: Heads-up: I pushed Pecten v2-int6 (per-channel + stochastic rounding) to staging for the embed pipeline. Running a quick quality audit today.
tony: thanks. I can run pairwise-angle distribution and recall@1/5/20 across the usual buckets. dataset = prod-simset-50k?
mai: yes 50k. include multilingual subset and punctuation-only filter. also compute embedding-norm-variance per bucket.
eval-bot: Job 110442 queued by rae. model=pecten-v2-int6 dataset=prod-simset-50k subsets=short,medium,long,multilang metrics=recall@1,5,20;silhouette;pairwise_angle_hist;norm_var seeds=5
tony: quick note: tokenization changes in tokenizer v1.3 caused a few outliers last week. can we freeze tokenizer for these runs?
rae: freeze tokenizer v1.2 for fairness. will add to job config.
mai: running now. config snippet: ```eval/run.sh --model pecten-v2-int6 --tokenizer v1.2 --dataset prod-simset-50k --buckets short,medium,long,multilang --metrics recall@1,5,20,silhouette,pairwise_angle,norm_var --seeds 5```
ops-bot: Serving: staged pecten-v2-int6 on cluster-2 (2 pods w/ kv-cache).
tony: early scalar: global recall@1 drop = 0.9% absolute vs baseline jasmine-emb-v3; short bucket recall@1 drop = 2.7% absolute. long bucket slightly up +0.4%.
rae: 2.7% on short is borderline. what's recall@5 and @20?
mai: recall@5 short down 1.0%, recall@20 short matched baseline (within noise). silhouette short down 0.03, pairwise-angle histogram shows a small left-shift (angles slightly larger -> cos smaller). norm variance increased for short by ~12%.
tony: that suggests quantization increased dispersion for short-context embeddings. maybe token-length correlates with L2 norm sensitivity.
rae: can we dump 15 failed short queries with their top5 per model? we need to determine top1 swap vs cluster split.
mai: sample dump:
```
q: "reset my password" (3 tokens)
baseline top1: "reset password steps" (cos=0.87)
pecten top1: "account recovery options" (cos=0.82)
pecten top2: "reset password steps" (cos=0.80)
```
several look like paraphrase reorderings. top1 swaps, not total drift.
tony: I pushed a quick per-layer clamp experiment: clamp weights in last attention out to 6-bit saturating then re-quant. re-run reduced short recall@1 gap to 1.1%.
rae: good. what's perf / cost impact?
ops-bot: Note: selective-clamp build increased latency p50 by +6ms and cost per token +9%.
mai: tradeoff seems reasonable if we can hit <1.5% recall@1 regression. Also: I computed topk-entropy for short bucket — pecten int6 entropy +0.12 bits vs baseline, consistent with more uncertainty.
tony: propose two mitigation branches: A) post-quant per-channel bias correction + stochastic rounding seed tuning B) selective-fp16 for projection layers (keep them in fp16). run both on 100k holdout.
rae: agree. add a canary rule: failover to jasmine-emb when short_recall@1_drop > 2.0% for 5m window or when topk_entropy increase >0.1 bits.
ops-bot: Canary trigger added: short_recall1_drop_pct=2.0, topk_entropy_delta=0.1.
mai: FYI I found 23 queries in short bucket that are punctuation-only or single-emoji; they inflate variance. I filtered them and short recall@1 gap shrank by ~0.4% absolute. we should exclude these from primary SLOs.
tony: running holdout jobs now: job 110443 (bias-corr), job 110444 (selective-fp16). each ~1h on 100k holdout. seeds=3.
rae: please also export uMAPs and a cosine-heatmap delta (baseline -> pecten) for short cluster. visual diffs help triage.
mai: attaching early uMAP notes: clusters preserved but short cluster centroid moved ~0.06 cosine units; intra-cluster variance up ~9%.
tony: small code snippet I used for pairwise-angle histogram sampling:
```
# sample pairs within bucket
pairs = sample_pairs(embs, n=200k)
angles = 1 - np.dot(pairs.a, pairs.b)
hist, bins = np.histogram(angles, bins=100)
```
rae: action items: 1) tony complete holdouts and post results; 2) mai prepare 30 qualitative failing examples for model card + tokenization notes; 3) ops add canary and rollback playbook to ticket; 4) if either branch gets recall@1 gap <=1.5% and cost improvement >15%, we can canary-deploy with fallback.
mai: will draft model card blurb: "Pecten v2-int6: ~15% cost reduction, sensitive to very short/punctuation queries; recommend canary fallback to jasmine-emb and tokenization freeze v1.2 for evaluation."
ops-bot: Jobs 110443/110444 queued. estimated 65m each.
tony: small heads-up: we should monitor embedding L2 norm distribution shift in prod for first 24h if canaryed; add alert for >10% norm_var increase on short bucket.
rae: ack. schedule ops window if holdouts look clean. thanks all. keeping thread for follow-ups.
